instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy cube SQL metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
SELECT SUM(fact_sales.revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM fact_sales
output: Total Revenue = SUM(fact_sales[revenue])

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy calculated metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Profit Margin
Expression: (SUM(revenue) - SUM(cost)) / SUM(revenue)
output:
Profit Margin = 
DIVIDE(
    SUM(fact_sales[revenue]) - SUM(fact_sales[cost]),
    SUM(fact_sales[revenue])
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy calculated metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Avg Order Value
Expression: SUM(revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)
output:
Avg Order Value = 
DIVIDE(
    SUM(fact_orders[revenue]),
    DISTINCTCOUNT(fact_orders[order_id])
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy calculated metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Cost Per Unit
Expression: SUM(total_cost) / SUM(quantity_sold)
output:
Cost Per Unit = 
DIVIDE(
    SUM(fact_sales[total_cost]),
    SUM(fact_sales[quantity_sold])
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy calculated metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Discount Rate
Expression: SUM(discount_amount) / SUM(gross_revenue)
output:
Discount Rate = 
DIVIDE(
    SUM(fact_sales[discount_amount]),
    SUM(fact_sales[gross_revenue])
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy calculated metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Revenue Per Customer
Expression: SUM(revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)
output:
Revenue Per Customer = 
DIVIDE(
    SUM(fact_sales[revenue]),
    DISTINCTCOUNT(fact_sales[customer_id])
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy calculated metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Inventory Turnover
Expression: SUM(units_sold) / AVG(inventory_on_hand)
output:
Inventory Turnover = 
DIVIDE(
    SUM(fact_sales[units_sold]),
    AVERAGE(fact_inventory[inventory_on_hand])
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy calculated metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Return Rate
Expression: COUNT(DISTINCT returned_order_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)
output:
Return Rate = 
DIVIDE(
    DISTINCTCOUNT(fact_returns[returned_order_id]),
    DISTINCTCOUNT(fact_orders[order_id])
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy calculated metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Net Margin Per Order
Expression: (SUM(revenue) - SUM(cost)) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)
output:
Net Margin Per Order = 
DIVIDE(
    SUM(fact_sales[revenue]) - SUM(fact_sales[cost]),
    DISTINCTCOUNT(fact_sales[order_id])
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy cube SQL metric with a filter condition into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
SELECT SUM(revenue) 
FROM fact_sales
WHERE region = 'APAC' AND product_category = 'Electronics'
output:
APAC Electronics Revenue = 
CALCULATE(
    SUM(fact_sales[revenue]),
    fact_sales[region] = "APAC",
    fact_sales[product_category] = "Electronics"
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy conditional metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: High Value Orders
Expression: SUM(revenue) WHERE order_value > 10000
output:
High Value Orders = 
CALCULATE(
    SUM(fact_orders[revenue]),
    FILTER(fact_orders, fact_orders[order_value] > 10000)
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy cube SQL metric with a filter condition into a Power BI DAX measure.

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy conditional metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Overdue Invoice Amount
Expression: SUM(invoice_amount) WHERE due_date < TODAY AND payment_status = 'Unpaid'
output:
Overdue Invoice Amount = 
CALCULATE(
    SUM(fact_invoices[invoice_amount]),
    fact_invoices[due_date] < TODAY(),
    fact_invoices[payment_status] = "Unpaid"
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy time-intelligence metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Revenue YTD
Expression: SUM(revenue) year-to-date based on order_date
output:
Revenue YTD = 
TOTALYTD(
    SUM(fact_sales[revenue]),
    DIM_DATE[date]
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy time-intelligence metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Revenue MoM Growth
Expression: (Current Month Revenue - Prior Month Revenue) / Prior Month Revenue
output:
Revenue MoM Growth = 
VAR CurrentMonth = SUM(fact_sales[revenue])
VAR PriorMonth = CALCULATE(SUM(fact_sales[revenue]), DATEADD(DIM_DATE[date], -1, MONTH))
RETURN
DIVIDE(CurrentMonth - PriorMonth, PriorMonth)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy time-intelligence metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Revenue Prior Year
Expression: SUM(revenue) same period last year based on order_date
output:
Revenue Prior Year = 
CALCULATE(
    SUM(fact_sales[revenue]),
    SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(DIM_DATE[date])
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy time-intelligence metric into a Power BI DAX measure.

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy time-intelligence metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:

Revenue YoY Growth =

)
